title: An exact four-class joint set for a rank-two equal-eigenvalue response matrix
checked_scope: Unrestricted common rotations and grouped variance shares; four single-label classes with A_H having spectrum(a,a,0,0)
significance: Constructively characterizes the full joint identified set at a higher-rank horizon as the capped simplex, using an elementary planar-vector construction rather than only coordinate bounds.
